content.text: {"summary":"The Googies are projected 116.1 to 94.6 against Team 5 and keep their current Yahoo lineup. The main question is Zay Flowers, who was limited Wednesday with a hamstring injury; Jordan Addison starts instead if Flowers is limited again by Friday. Jayden Daniels and Nico Collins are out and stay on the bench. Olamide Zaccheaus is the waiver option if receiver depth runs short."}
